source_statement: Manuscript: 'A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion' (OpenAI, Oct 7 2026; sections identical to Sep 24 2026). Grade: IMPORTED_PREPRINT (unrefereed, AI-generated, no Lean). Main theorem, introduction.tex:22-30: 'Let E/Q be an elliptic curve with E(Q)[2] != 0 and s_2(E) in {0,1}. Then ord_{s=1} L(E,s) = rank_Z E(Q) = s_2(E), Sha(E/Q) is finite.' Standing hypotheses of CO (CO:12-20): S contains 2 and the primes dividing N; filter indices h = sigma D with D>0 squarefree; adjoined primes odd, good, outside support; F = Q(E[2]) 'trivial or quadratic'; v(2)=1. Detector setup (CO:140-157): 'Choose a fixed negative odd fundamental discriminant h_* with L(E^{(h_*)},1) != 0, whose local squareclasses agree with those of the filter at 2N ... |h_*|>4 ... K_D = Q(sqrt(D h_*)) is imaginary, split at 2N, and has only the units {1,-1}. Fix a modular parametrization phi with phi(infty)=0 throughout.' P_D (CO:168-171): 'P_D = sum_{[a] in Pic(O_{K_D})} chi_D([a]) phi(x_D^{[a]})'; CO:184-185: 'Put j(P_D)=+infty if the product derivative vanishes.' Lemma co:kummer (CO:187-207), verbatim: 'Let C act on T=T_2E as complex conjugation, and choose a nonzero integral row b: T -> Z_2 with bC=b. For a fixed positive simple-zero witness D_w, there are arbitrarily large precisions M and good primes ell such that rho_T(Fr_ell) = C (mod 2^M), (h_*/ell) = -1, (D_w/ell) = 1. Evaluation at Frobenius squared defines an integral homomorphism lambda_M: E(F_{ell^2}) -> Z/2^M Z, lambda_M = b kappa_M, of Frobenius sign +1. The valuation of lambda_M(red_ell(L P_{D_w})) is bounded independently of M, for a fixed nonzero integer L making the twist comparison integral.' Proof ends CO:251: 'Finally det C = -1 implies ell = -1 (mod 2^M).' Lemma co:theta-bridge (CO:256-272), verbatim: 'For ell as in Lemma co:kummer, the reduced modular parametrization followed by lambda_M admits an integral weighted ternary theta lift. After extraction of the coefficients at multiples of |h_*| it gives a classical holomorphic weight-3/2 form g_M = sum a_M(n) q^n, of level supported on S u {ell}, with (co:recurrence) modulo 2^M. ... For squarefree admissible D, a_M(D) = c_0 2^{omega(N)} zeta_M(D) lambda_M(red_ell(L P_D)) (mod 2^M), where zeta_M(D) is a 2-power root of unity and c_0, L are fixed integers independent of D, M, ell. The extra index restriction at ell is (D/ell)=1.' Proof: B ramified at ell and infinity, R Eichler order of level N, X = B^x \ Bhat^x / Rhat^x (CO:275-289); P_M(z) = lambda_M(L phi_ell(z)) with Brandt eigenvalues a_p(E) away from N ell, 'These identities are modulo 2^M. Choose any integer lifts' (CO:295-302); theta sum H_M(n) = c_0 sum_{z in X} P_M(z) chi_{h_*}(Nrd z)/|R_z^x| sum_{x in B^0, Q(x)=n} f(z^{-1} x z) (CO:447-451); 'At n=|h_*|D the counted elements are precisely the optimal embeddings O_{K_D} -> R_z' (CO:490-491); orientation count 'Every one of the 2^{omega(N)+1} orientation tuples consequently has the same contribution' (CO:526-527). Proposition co:odd (CO:534-544): 'v(a_M(D)) >= min{M, j(P_D)-C}, v(a_M(D)) < M => j(P_D) <= v(a_M(D)) + C. A visible coefficient detects a(E^{(D)})=1'; proof imports Gross-Zagier (CO:547-550). The odd normalization is conditional on pw:odd-lower (CO:566-583; pointwise.tex:473-498), which imports the ring-class lower bound rd:missing-vertex (corank-one hypothesis).
what_it_would_need: The lemma family is a coefficient-prime-2, rank-one, base-level (X_0(N) -> E) identity. To become an input to any seed obligation it would need ALL of the following, none of which is in the manuscript: (T1) an odd-p analogue of co:kummer whose auxiliary primes lie in the lab's actual regime. The source's primes satisfy Fr_ell = C mod p^M (ell = -1, a_ell = 0 mod p^M). The G2 regime has Fr_ell = -I (ell = 1, a_ell = -2 mod p; no +1 line, b(-I)=b forces b=0). The BD positive-sign regime has Fr_ell = diag(1, ell) with p not dividing ell^2 - 1, so ell != -1 mod p, which excludes the source's primes outright. A new detector lemma with a row b compatible with diag(1,ell) (e.g. the ell-eigenline, which BD already uses as the singular/finite local line) is a different statement with a different Chebotarev/Kummer proof. (T2) a proved odd-p, raised-level weighted comparison on the lab's definite set S' = S(N^- ell_1 ell_2, N^+): i.e. the identity 'theta coefficient at |h_*| D = (orientation count) x (stabilizer factor) x detector(CM reduction)' with the Q_2 = H^1_fin(K_{ell_2}, V_J)-valued function q_m of CM_MAP_ATTEMPT.md eq.(1) in place of lambda_M(L phi_ell). The CM push already extracted the regime-independent part (orbit count n_s = |Emb_s|/e_s, identity (5) B_K(q_m) = beta) and explicitly declined the theta-series transformation law (CM_MAP_ATTEMPT.md:126). What is missing is the full local Schwartz-weight construction and Weil-representation modularity check for the raised quaternion algebras (CO:304-441 is done only for B ramified at {ell, infinity} and level N, at coefficient 2). (T3) the C8 two-place scalar comparison: an explicit p-adic unit/valuation relating Xi(B_K(q_m)) = C_K (x) R_P (CM_MAP_ATTEMPT.md eq.(6)) to the E-side point determinant R_P of (P_1, P_2) via the ell_1 toric realization. The source has no analogue: its scalar is pinned by phi: X_0(N)->E at base level, and the lab's X_1 admits no nonzero map J_1 -> E (CM_MAP_ATTEMPT.md:36). (T4) nonvanishing of the selected CM value. In the source this is Gross-Zagier at a simple zero (CO:547-550, co:kummer witness). For the seed (analytic order >= 2) the rank-one Heegner sum is torsion, so the only candidate is the Gross-packet second moment M_2(p) != 0 / two-point determinant, whose cost is the seed-scale Brandt enumeration (class set ~5e14, unaffordable). The source gives no cheaper evaluation: its theta side sums over the full supersingular set X (CO:448), and the cheap side (a single finite-field evaluation of a Heegner point on E) requires the base-level parametrization and a rank-one point, neither available in the BD lane. (T5) K-A: the source's uniform normalization of the odd coefficient (co:minimum, CO:594-614) is conditional on pw:odd-lower, which rests on rd:missing-vertex with 'Selmer corank over K is one'; the seed has corank 2 over every K (K-RANK2), so even the source's own normalization chain cannot be imported. Conclusion: the missing theorem is precisely (T1)+(T2)+(T3) = 'an odd-p, positive-sign-admissible, raised-level weighted theta comparison with an explicit scalar against the two-point regulator', and the missing computation is (T4). coefficients.tex supplies a template for the orbit/orientation bookkeeping inside (T2) only, and that template has already been consumed by the CM push.
obligation: Hypothetically: FIN uniform part via the BD/K-route lane (M_2(p) != 0 => Sha[p^infty] = 0 at good p >= 5), hence also in principle the good named remainder primes 59 and 487. It does NOT serve 2243, 4547, 5843 (BD/level-raising setup requires p not dividing N; the source's 'adjoined primes are odd, good' and p^e||N local models are for the level, not for the coefficient prime), does NOT serve ORDER9 or Q36 (no leading-term or size statement; the manuscript explicitly 'does not assert the full BSD leading-coefficient formula', introduction.tex:35-37), and does NOT serve lemma TH at 5843 (the source's theta is a weight-3/2 ternary theta on a definite algebra ramified at a good prime ell; TH concerns the first derivative at the trivial character of a level-raised anticyclotomic theta element at a multiplicative prime inert in K; no shared statement). No cost reduction for any lab computation (Ota witnesses at 59, 487; B.18 production symbols; c_1(lambda_ell) at 5843; Shii's Fitting comparison). Net: the lead currently feeds no obligation; its only use was bookkeeping already absorbed into CM_MAP_ATTEMPT.md eqs. (4)-(5).
new_observation: NEW-1 (three disjoint prime regimes, not two): Codex's screen opposed the source's C-regime to G2 (-I), and the CM push corrected that BD primes are diag(1,ell) rather than -I. Neither note records that the source's regime is ALSO disjoint from BD: co:kummer forces ell = -1 mod 2^M (CO:251), while BD positive-sign admissibility requires p not dividing ell^2 - 1 (CM_MAP_ATTEMPT.md:16), i.e. ell != -1 mod p. So co:kummer cannot be instantiated on any BD pair at odd p either; the CM push's correction rescues the orbit-count template, not the detector. NEW-2 (the seed is a zero of the source formula): with D=1 ('quadratic interpretation', CO:176) the free part of P_1 lies in E(Q) only at a simple zero (CO:179-180); for the seed, ord_{s=1} L(E,s) >= 2 so the product derivative vanishes, j(P_1) = +infty (CO:184-185) and a_M(1) = 0 mod 2^M (CO:578-580). The identity co:weighted-comparison evaluated at the seed reads 0 = 0; there is no rank-two information in it, so even a perfect odd-p transplant would detect nothing about E. Rank-two content in this manuscript lives only in the derivative-class machinery of ring-determinants.tex (already screened by Codex with rank-one hypotheses). NEW-3 (hypothesis the seed does satisfy): E(Q)_tors = Z/2 so E(Q)[2] != 0 and F = Q(E[2]) is quadratic (22735^2 - 4*106272484 = 91790289 is not a square), i.e. the seed is inside the manuscript's residual range; thm:main still fails for E by s_2(E) = 2 (K-RANK2). For E^{-7} (also rational 2-torsion, s_2 = 0) thm:main would give ord L(E^{-7},1) = 0 and Sha(E^{-7}) finite, which is already PROVED via L(E^{-7},1) != 0 + GZK, so U1 is vacuous for this manuscript. NEW-4 (conductor shape not an obstruction to the bookkeeping): the source's local Eichler-order model handles p^e||N with a cyclic level quotient (CO:306-324) and 'arbitrary depth at 2' (CO:288-289, 326-339), so the seed's 2^3 and 4547^2 are within the template's scope; the orientation count would be 2^{omega(N)+1} = 64 for the seed. NEW-5 (thin spots in the manuscript's own proof): (a) co:kummer's proof (CO:232-241) elides the cocycle calculation; the translation of (Cg)^2 is (1+C)(c(C)+v), so b of it is 2 b(c(C)) + 2 b(v), and 'fixed finite nonzero valuation' needs b(v) chosen in the full lattice 2^a Z_2 to avoid cancellation with the fixed term b(c(C)); the argument is repairable but unwritten. (b) co:theta-bridge asserts Brandt eigenvalues a_p(E) for P_M only 'modulo 2^M' and then chooses 'any integer lifts' (CO:299-302); g_M is modular by Weil but satisfies the Hecke recurrence only mod 2^M, so the Waldspurger ratio of co:even is unavailable for the odd source and its normalization is routed through pw:odd-lower (corank-one ring-class input). (c) The level-ell Schwartz weight uses 'ell = -1 (mod 4)' (CO:373) which is implied by ell = -1 mod 2^M for M >= 2 but is never stated as a hypothesis of co:theta-bridge. NEW-6 (version): all ten section files are byte-identical between the Sep-24 and Oct-7 directories; the historical Oct-6 Claude screen's September pin therefore read the same text, and Codex's 'version diff not completed' (ADJACENT_ARITHMETIC.md:87) can be closed: no repair of either rank-two gap occurred in the revision.
risks: K-GRADE: every statement quoted is IMPORTED_PREPRINT (unrefereed, AI-generated, no Lean entry for the BSD family); nothing here may be cited above that grade. K-A: the odd coefficient normalization chain (co:minimum -> pw:odd-lower -> rd:missing-vertex) assumes Selmer corank one over K; importing any normalized odd symbol into the seed lane would silently assume the desired low-corank conclusion. K-RANK2: thm:main and the odd detector are structurally blind to a curve of analytic order >= 2 (NEW-2); applying them to E is impossible, and applying them to E^{-7} gives nothing new. Transplant risk: carrying the source's 'bC = b' row or 'ell = -1 mod p^M' prime choice into the BD lane is not merely a mismatch but a contradiction with the admissibility hypothesis p not dividing ell^2 - 1 (NEW-1). Cost risk: no cost reduction is available; the theta side requires the full supersingular class set, so any evaluation campaign motivated by this lead would reopen the unaffordable seed-scale Brandt enumeration. Proof risk inside the source: the Weil-representation modularity checks (CO:399-441) and the cocycle step of co:kummer (NEW-5) were read, not independently verified; the manuscript imports Gross-Zagier, Waldspurger, Jetchev-Kane, Cornut-Jetchev, Faltings, Bogomolov and Carayol at their published grades. Dependency: the manuscript cites the broader OpenAI Goldfeld 2-converse companion but states it is 'not an input to the proof' (introduction.tex:39-43); no withdrawal is recorded in history.md. Recommendation: close L1 as 'template already consumed by the CM push; no residual lead'; do not launch a source map audit beyond the one already done in CM_MAP_ATTEMPT.md, and do not relabel the orbit-count identity (5) as a scalar comparison or a bound.
